summary: LightInTheBox Holding Co., Ltd. filed a Form 6-K reporting the appointment of Jian He as Chairman of the Board, effective June 2, 2026. The filing does not indicate that the appointment was forced or abrupt; however, because the change is itself the event rather than a routine agenda item, it is classified as a management change. No financial terms, consideration, or advisor are mentioned. The registrant is the issuer. What to watch: whether the appointment signals broader strategic shifts or governance changes.
